output.plan: Find the semester with the latest start_date, then average the non-NULL grades of all enrollments in offerings of that semester. If that semester has no grades yet, the average comes back NULL.
output.sql: WITH latest AS (SELECT id, name, start_date FROM semesters ORDER BY start_date DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT l.id AS semester_id, l.name AS semester_name, AVG(e.grade) AS average_grade, COUNT(e.grade) AS graded_enrollments FROM latest l LEFT JOIN course_offerings co ON co.semester_id = l.id LEFT JOIN enrollments e ON e.offering_id = co.id GROUP BY l.id, l.name
